blocks.text: 跨财政年度培训会批准简报
批准结论与可执行备选
目标先最大化可合规人数，再在同人数下选最低含储备总额。24人方案中仅 Phoenix 在当前上限内，因此为推荐方案；其四晚报价 $155 低于两财年 $160 住宿上限。可执行备选为 Phoenix 18人，总额 $40,480.86，余量 $12,519.14；如需保留24人而票价上涨，应先锁定合格票价或提高已批准上限，不得以储备替代授权。
20%机票压力下，Phoenix 24人总额为 $53,744.88，超限 $744.88。维持24人时，平均往返机票须不高于 $582.44/人；否则改为当前仍合格的18人方案（Phoenix 18人压力总额 $42,408.66），或在承诺支出前取得更高预算上限。
六方案比较
逐日每人限额与M&IE（默认到达日）
Chicago, IL（Cook）
每人M&IE合计：$234.00；住宿税按可报销报价计，四晚税 $104.64。
Denver, CO（Denver）
每人M&IE合计：$234.00；住宿税按可报销报价计，四晚税 $100.32。
Phoenix, AZ（Maricopa）
每人M&IE合计：$223.00；住宿税按可报销报价计，四晚税 $74.40。
费率来源、跨年与计算口径

GSA网页快照实际链接：FY25费率 https://www.gsa.gov/system/files/FY2025_PerDiemMasterRatesFile.xlsx；FY26费率 https://www.gsa.gov/system/files/FY2026_PerDiemMasterRatesFile.xlsx；FY25至今M&IE拆分 https://www.gsa.gov/system/files/FY%202025%20MIE%20Breakdown.docx。费率按旅行日、财政年度（10月1日换年）、县/目的地和季节进入Daily；M&IE文件提供餐别扣减及首末日金额。

Chicago: FY25 Master行258，FY26 Master行254；Denver: FY25 Master行109，FY26 Master行107；Phoenix: FY25 Master行22，FY26 Master行18。两版须分别留证；本行程匹配结果恰好相同：Chicago $223/$92，Denver $215/$92，Phoenix $160/$86，所以跨年未实际改变限额或M&IE，但不能用FY25行替代10月旅行日的FY26依据。

FTR §§301-11.100、301-11.27：住宿按实际成本、不超过上限；住宿税不含在住宿上限中，且仅按可报销住宿计。本预算以报价（而非上限）为住宿支出，并以其12%估税。§§301-11.101–102及§301-11.18：首末日先取75%，再扣完整餐别金额，且不低于$5杂费。§301-74.21：政府/注册费所含正餐扣减，茶歇不扣；免费酒店早餐依据§301-11.17及GSA拆分表说明不扣。无人有已批准例外。
批准条件与责任

Travel authorization and reimbursable-cost basis｜Travel authorizing official｜期限：Before ticketing/booking; target 2025-08-15｜阻断：YES。证据：Signed travel authorizations; itinerary; Daily and Options review; meal-deduction acknowledgment; TMS itinerary。

Actual-expense authorization (only if later needed)｜Official designated by agency head｜期限：Before travel and before any over-cap commitment｜阻断：CONDITIONAL—YES if exception is used。证据：Advance written actual-expense authorization and justification for any over-cap lodging/meal proposal。

Hotel fire-safe / approved accommodation｜Conference coordinator with agency lodging/safety reviewer｜期限：Before facility selection/obligation; target 2025-07-31｜阻断：YES。证据：Property identity; approved-accommodation/fire-safety listing evidence; TMS/FedRooms or agency-approved booking record; waiver if applicable。

Venue procurement and price reasonableness｜Contracting officer｜期限：Before obligation; target 2025-07-31｜阻断：YES。证据：Final quote; statement of work; competition or authorized exception; price analysis; signed instrument; cancellation terms。

Funds availability and cross-fiscal-year funding｜Budget officer / funds certifying official｜期限：Before obligation; target 2025-07-31｜阻断：YES。证据：Written funds certification; accounting citation(s); bona-fide-need/cross-year determination; treatment of reserve and cancellation exposure。

Meal and agenda validation｜Conference coordinator and travel reviewer｜期限：Before travel authorization; refresh by 2025-09-15｜阻断：YES。证据：Final agenda, registration inclusions, catering order, attendee notice, and Daily reconciliation。

Agency conference/training approval｜Designated conference/training approving official｜期限：Before obligation; target 2025-07-31｜阻断：YES if agency policy requires。证据：Agency-required approval memorandum, attendance justification, and delegations。

Airfare stress control｜Travel manager and budget officer｜期限：Before ticketing; monitor through purchase｜阻断：YES if airfare exceeds baseline and selected option would exceed ceiling。证据：Fare quote/hold showing Phoenix-24 average round trip at or below $582.44, or documented switch to eligible 18-person option, or approved ceiling increase。
采购、资金确认和机构会议审批的具体表单/期限属于建议的内部控制或机构程序，并非在本简报中冒充FTR明文。酒店/会场仍须核实正式住宿与消防安全、采购及资金条件；本题报价本身不构成批准。
交付与回算提示
conference_budget.xlsx 的五个黄色输入可编辑；Daily、Options、资格、推荐和压力措施使用工作簿内公式，并暴露指定工作簿级命名输入/输出。WF_SNAPSHOT_CURRENT 仅在五项输入均为默认值时为TRUE。本文和approval_register.csv均为默认参数静态快照；任一输入改变后须重新导出，二者不会自动更新。
